structured.rankingRationale: Top rank goes to OENOVITI because it is a dated multi-day event in Nyon/La Côte, closest to the hotel market. CERN workshops and SETAC follow for dated scientific demand and airport accessibility. Swiss IT and exhibitor-led Palexpo events are actionable but venue-committed. Geneva Dry, Geneva Enterprise AI Summit and the Four Seasons incentive offer rank lower because named competitors or incumbent programme ownership constrain current-edition accessibility. No attendance or room estimates were used.
notesForDeepResearch: Prioritize OENOVITI for La Côte geographic fit, then CERN workshops and SETAC for airport-corridor fit.
For Palexpo events, identify exhibitors, sponsors, speakers, PCOs and overflow requirements rather than pitching as primary congress hotel.
Treat Geneva Dry, Geneva Enterprise AI Summit and Four Seasons incentive offer as competitive-market intelligence unless an uncontracted subprogramme is evidenced.
materialUncertainties: No candidate has a published YOTEL room block or confirmed YOTEL booking.
Geneva airport-corridor relevance is plausible for selected subgroups, not automatic full-event housing.
For venue-confirmed events, hotel sourcing remains unconfirmed unless the source explicitly names hotels.
The incentive item is a marketed programme offer, not a confirmed client trip.
